lines: Jo kabhi bin bole sab samajh jaate the,
Aaj unhe apni baat samjhana bhi ek bojh lagta hai.
Log badalte hain toh dard utna nahi hota,
Jitna unke badalne ka tareeka tod deta hai.
Pehle roz ki aadat the hum unki,
Aaj ek mulaqaat ke liye bhi waqt nahi hai unke paas.
Kisi ko toot kar chahne se behtar tha,
Khud se thoda sa khudgarz ho jaate toh bach jaate.
Jinhe apna maana tha wahi gair nikle,
Ab kisi aur se wafa ki ummeed kya hi karein.
Narazgi toh apno se hoti hai,
Par jab apne hi ajnabi ban jaayein toh khamoshi hi sahi.
Rishte badal jaate hain bina kisi aahat ke,
Aur hum wahin khade purani yaadein gin-te reh jaate hain.
Sabse bada dhokha tab milta hai,
Jab fark padna band ho jaaye usko jiske bina tumhara guzara nahi tha.
Wafadaari ki baatein sab karte hain,
Par nibhane ki baari aaye toh pehle wahi peeche hat-te hain.
Kal tak jo har baat baantte the humse,
Aaj unke baare mein dusron se pata chalta hai.
Kuch log paas hokar bhi itne door ho jaate hain,
Ki unki awaaz bhi ab parayi lagti hai.
Badal gaye hain wo jinke badalne ka kabhi khayal bhi nahi tha,
Zindagi ne har ek galatfahmi door kar di.
Ab toh unka badla hua roop dekh kar darr lagta hai,
Kya yeh wahi hain jin par aankh moond kar yakeen kiya tha?
Apno se mile zakhm bohot gehre hote hain,
Bhar toh jaate hain par nishaaniyaan kabhi nahi jaati.
Rishta tootne par itna dard nahi hota,
Jitna rishte mein reh kar akelepan ka ehsaas hota hai.
Humne toh sirf wafadaari di thi unse,
Par unhone humari seedhi tabiyet ko bewakoofi samajh liya.
Pehle wo hume khone se darte the,
Ab humare hone na hone se koi fark nahi padta unhe.
Zaroorat thi jab sabse zyada unki,
Tab hi unhone apna asli chehra dikhaya.
Baatein wahi hain par wo jazbaat nahi rahe,
Apne toh hain par wo puraani mithaas nahi rahi.
Wajah toh bohot thi unke paas rukh badalne ki,
Par hum toh bas unke ek ishare par tike rehte the.
Mohabbat thi isliye jaane diya,
Agar ghamand hota toh baahon mein hoti.
Dil bhi tumhara tha, mohabbat bhi tumhari thi,
Bas akelapan mera ho gaya hamesha ke liye.
Hume kahan maloom tha ki ishq hota kya hai,
Bas tum mile aur zindagi pehle mohabbat ban gayi... phir dard.
Tumne toh sirf waqt guzaarne ke liye naam liya tha,
Hum khaamkhaah khud ko tumhari poori duniya samajh baithe.
Badi ajeeb si mohabbat ki kahani thi tumhari,
Pehle apna banaya, phir paraya, phir ajnabi.
Hum bhi muskuraate the kabhi bina wajah,
Ab toh wajah dhundhni padti hai muskurane ke liye.
Koi mila hi nahi jis par dil lagaate,
Har ek ne dhokha diya, kis kis ko yaad rakhein.
Kaash tum samajh paate mere dil ka dard,
Toh yun bewajah hume tanha na chodte.
Tum muskuraate hue ache lagte the,
Isliye humne rote hue bhi tumhe alvida keh diya.
Tere bina ye dil ab dhadakta toh hai,
Par sirf saans lene ke liye, khushi ke liye nahi.
Kitna bhi khayal rakho kisi ka, kam lagta hai,
Jab apna hi koi badal jaaye, toh sab toot jaata hai.
Ek tarfa mohabbat bhi kitni ajeeb hoti hai na,
Takleef apni hoti hai aur galti bhi kisi ki nahi.
Naam tera hi rahega meri har saans mein,
Chahe tu mujhe yaad rakhe ya bhula de.
Tumhari khushi ke liye door hue the tumse,
Warna humari mohabbat mein koi kami nahi thi.
Chaha tha tumhe jaan se bhi zyada,
Par tum toh sirf ek sapna bankar reh gaye.
Kabhi fursat ho toh sochna zaroor,
Ek tathakathit beparwah tumhari itni parwah kyun karta tha.
Mohabbat mein haarna bura nahi lagta,
Bura tab lagta hai jab apna hi koi hara de.
Hum toh unke liye ek mamuli insaan the,
Aur wo humare liye poori duniya.
Wo chale gaye hume akela choddkar,
Par unki yaadein aaj bhi yahin rehti hain.
Kitni ajeeb baat hai na, tum ab mere nahi ho,
Phir bhi ye dil tumhe hi yaad karta hai.
Bohot chhupaya maine is duniya se,
Par meri aankhon ne sab bayan kar diya.
Ab koi ummeed nahi bachi tere aane ki,
Phir bhi ye nazrein door par hi tik jaati hain.
Faasle aise bhi honge kabhi socha na tha,
Saamne baitha tha wo aur wo mera nahi tha.
Chupchap guzar jaate hain wo raaston se,
Jo kabhi meri aahat par bhi ruk jaaya karte the.
Dooriyon se hi pata chalta hai,
Kaun kitna qareeb hai sachchi mein.
Jab apna hi koi chhod jaata hai,
Toh poori duniya par se bharosa uth jaata hai.
Bichhad kar tumse bas itna hi seekha hai,
Ki mohabbat jitni gehri hogi, zakhm utna hi bada hoga.
Ab koi shikayat nahi hai tumse,
Kyunki galti tumhari nahi, meri umeedein galat thin.
Tumse door jaana meri marzi nahi thi,
Bas tumhare liye hi tumhe chhodna pada.
Na jaane kaisi dushmani thi kismat ki humse,
Jisse bhi dil lagaya, wahi door ho gaya.
Raaste alag ho gaye toh kya hua,
Manzil toh meri aaj bhi tum hi ho.
Khamoshi bohot kuch kehti hai,
Kaan lagakar nahi, dil lagakar suno.
Ab toh har khushi mein bhi ek udaasi chhupa hoti hai,
Jab se tum door gaye ho, ye dil rota hai.
Alvida kehte waqt wo muskura diye,
Aur hum unki khushi ke liye ro bhi na sake.
Tum chale gaye par tumhari khushboo aaj bhi baaki hai,
Is veeraan dil mein teri yaad hi kaafi hai.
Faasle toh sirf jismani hain,
Warna ye dil toh aaj bhi tumhare paas hi hai.
Bohot dard hota hai jab koi apna,
Achanak ajnabi ban jaata hai.
Ab toh raaton ki neend bhi chheen li tumhari yaadon ne,
Aur tum kehte ho ki hum tumhe yaad nahi karte.
Kaash wo waqt wahin tham jaata,
Jab tum mere paas the aur sab kuch behtar tha.
Tere jaane ke baad ye shehar bhi veeraan lagta hai,
Har koi ajnabi, har chehra anjaana lagta hai.
Zakhm itne diye tumne ki ab dard mehsoos nahi hota,
Dil aisa toota ki ab koi apna nahi lagta.
Jhoothe waade aur kasmein di thi tumne,
Aur hum bewakoof aankh moondkar maan baithe.
Jis par sabse zyada bharosa tha,
Usi ne sabse bada dhokha diya.
Mohabbat mein bewafai ka zehar ghol diya tumne,
Ek hasta hua dil tadapkar tod diya tumne.
Kabhi socha na tha ki ek din tum bhi badal jaoge,
Duniya ki tarah tum bhi mujhse muh mod loge.
Khel acha khela tumne mere dil ke saath,
Jeet tumhari hui aur haar meri mohabbat ki.
Chehre badal gaye, insaan badal gaye,
Waqt ke saath unke iraade badal gaye.
Kitna aasaan tha tumhare liye alvida kehna,
Aur kitna mushkil hai mere liye akele rehna.
Ab kisi par bharosa nahi hota,
Kyunki sachcha pyaar ab baar baar nahi milta.
Sheeshe ka dil tha mera, tumne patthar maarkar tod diya,
Beech raah mein laakar akele hi chhod diya.
Tumhari baaton mein jo mithaas thi,
Wo darasal ek meetha zehar tha.
Badal jaate hain wo log waqt ki tarah,
Jinhe had se zyada pyaar diya jaata hai.
Dil todne ke liye shukriya tumhe,
Kam se kam ab hum kisi par nirbhar toh nahi karenge.
Bewafai ki bhi hadd hoti hai,
Tumne toh meri wafadaari ka mazaak bana diya.
Bharosa ek baar toot jaaye toh phir kabhi jud nahi paata,
Chahe insaan kitna bhi maafi maange.
Tum toh badal gaye apni suvidha ke hisaab se,
Par hum aaj bhi wahin khade hain tumhari yaad mein.
Dard is baat ka nahi ki tum kisi aur ke ho gaye,
Dard is baat ka hai ki tumne mujhe jhoothi umeedein diye.
Sach hi kaha hai kisine,
Zaroorat khatam toh rishte bhi khatam.
Ab tumhe fark nahi padta mere rone ya hasne se,
Kyunki tum toh aage badh chuke ho naye logon ke saath.
Humari wafadaari ko tumne meri majboori samjha,
Aur khud ko begunah sabit kar diya.
Ye raatein bohot lambi lagti hain,
Jab teri yaadein dil par dastak deti hain.
Sab so jaate hain apni apni khushiyon ke saath,
Aur hum apni purani yaadein seene se lagakar rote hain.
Aaj phir teri yaad ne rula diya,
Sote hue dil ko phir se jaga diya.
Raaton ki khamoshi bohot kuch keh jaati hai,
Jab koi apna bas yaadon mein reh jaata hai.
Tumhari puraani baatein padh kar muskaan aa jaati hai,
Aur phir apni bebasi par aansu baha leta hoon.
Andhera hi acha hai is ujaale se,
Kam se kam mere aansu kisi ko dikhte toh nahi.
Kitni raatein guzaari hain jaag jaag kar,
Sirf ek tumhare sandesh ke intezaar mein.
Tumhari yaadein bhi bilkul tumhari tarah hain,
Bina bataaye aa jaati hain aur rulakar chali jaati hain.
Ye chand bhi aaj akela lagta hai,
Bilkul meri tarah is aasmaan mein.
Sapno mein hi sahi, tum aaj bhi mere paas aate ho,
Par subah aankh khulte hi phir se tanha chhod jaate ho.
Neend ab aankhon mein aati hi nahi,
Tumhari yaadein dil se jaati hi nahi.
Khamosh raat, udaas dil aur teri yaad,
Bas yahi bacha hai ab meri zindagi mein tumhare baad.
Takiye ko bhigokar sona ab aadat ban gayi hai,
Tere bina ye zindagi ek sazaa ban gayi hai.
Guzra hua waqt bohot yaad aata hai,
Jab tum mere qareeb the aur sab kuch theek tha.
Har raat ek hi sawaal aata hai zehan mein,
Kya tumhe bhi kabhi meri yaad aati hai?
Wo tasveerein aaj bhi mehfooz hain mere paas,
Jinme tum mera haath thaam kar muskura rahe the.
Yaadon ka saagar umad aata hai raat hote hi,
Aur hum doob jaate hain tere khayalon mein.
Kitna aasaan hota na agar yaadon ko bhi mitaya ja sakta,
Toh kaash main is takleef se aaj azaad hota.
Raaton ko uth uthkar rona koi humse pooche,
Mohabbat ka sachcha dard koi humse pooche.
Khamoshi bolti hai aur hum sunte hain,
Andhere mein baithkar teri hi yaadein chunte hain.
Bheed mein bhi akela mehsoos karta hoon,
Jab se tumse baat hona band hui hai.
Hasna toh chhod diya hai humne logon ke liye,
Bas jhoothi muskaan de dete hain dard chhupane ke liye.
Zindagi toh chal rahi hai apni raftaar se,
Par dil wahin ruk gaya hai jahan tumne chhoda tha.
Ab kisi naye insaan se milne ka dil nahi karta,
Dar lagta hai ki wo bhi tumhari tarah chhod na jaaye.
Tootkar bikhra hoon is qadar,
Ki ab khud ko jodna naamumkin lagta hai.
Dard chhupana seekh liya hai maine,
Ab chehre par jhoothi muskaan sajana seekh liya hai maine.
Log poochte hain itne chup kyun rehte ho,
Ab unhe kya batayein ki andar kitna toofaan hai.
Zindagi mein kuch mod aise bhi aate hain,
Jahan chahkar bhi insaan muskura nahi paata.
Akele chalna seekh liya hai maine,
Kyunki saath chalne waale aksar raah badal lete hain.
Ab kisi se koi ummeed nahi rakhta,
Kyunki ummeedein hi dard ki wajah banti hain.
Ye dil ab khaali khaali sa lagta hai,
Jaise ismein ab koi armaan hi na bacha ho.
Rone se dard kam nahi hota,
Par dil ka bojh thoda halka ho jaata hai.
Zindagi ne bohot kuch sikhaya,
Par tumhare bina jeena nahi sikhaya.
Ab toh dard bhi apna sa lagta hai,
Aur khushiyan ajnabi si lagti hain.
Kaash koi aisa hota jo dil ka haal samajh paata,
Bina kuch kahe meri aankhon ke aansoo padh paata.
Har roz khud se ek hi vaada karta hoon,
Ki aaj tumhe yaad nahi karunga... aur phir haar jaata hoon.
Dil ka tootna bhi bohot khamosh hota hai,
Na koi awaaz hoti hai na koi dhamaka... bas sab khatam ho jaata hai.
Ab toh khud se bhi nafrat hone lagi hai,
Kyunki ye dil aaj bhi sirf tumhe hi chahta hai.
Sab kehte hain waqt har zakhm bhar deta hai,
Par kuch zakhm itne gehre hote hain ki waqt bhi haar jaata hai.
Ab bas sukoon ki talaash hai,
Chahe wo zindagi mein mile ya uske baad.
